title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, improve caching and concurrency hygiene
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflow has grown slow and brittle — lint, unit tests, integration tests, and release automation run in a single file with duplicated caching logic. This PR splits the workflows into focused files (lint, test, release), consolidates cache helpers, and improves job concurrency/rate limits to reduce CI queue times and flakiness. Goals: 1) Reduce average CI run time for PRs by splitting work so quick feedback (lint/unit) is prioritized; 2) Improve cache hit rates across repos by centralizing cache keys and helper scripts; 3) Harden release automation (tagging/release notes) with additional checks and retries; 4) Simplify workflow maintenance and reduce duplication. Changes in this PR: - Split .github/workflows/ci.yml into three workflows: lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml. - Introduced .github/actions/cache-utils (shell helper + small TS wrapper) to produce stable cache keys across node matrix and workspace permutations. - Adjusted matrix sizes and concurrency/grouping to avoid excessive parallelism against shared runners (adds concurrency groups and rate limits). - Standardized node versions to Node 20 in build/test jobs and used a single centralized setup-node action version. - Fixed several flaky integration tests by adding explicit DB cleanup step and increasing test timeouts guarded by a feature flag. - Reworked release workflow to run only on release/* branches and tags, with a required manual approval gate for production releases. - Added new lint job to run early in the pipeline and fail fast for style/type issues. Rollout plan: landed behind a feature flag (ci.split_workflows) in the repo config and enabled gradually for high-activity teams. Monitoring: added CI job-level metrics emitted to our observability pack (ci.job.duration, ci.cache.hit_rate). Related: ENG-4871 (CI reliability), ENG-4920 (developer velocity).
commits: initial: split workflows into lint/test/release and move legacy steps into scripts/ci-legacy.sh
feat(cache): add cache-utils script and typescript wrapper for consistent keys
chore: upgrade setup-node to v4 and standardize node 20 across jobs
fix(tests): add DB cleanup and increase jest timeout for flakey integration tests
ci(release): add manual approval gate and retry step for publish job
review_comments: Daniel Kim: Overall direction makes sense. A few asks: ensure cache key includes lockfile hash and node version; please add a canary flag to enable the new workflows per-repo.
Aisha Patel (author): Added lockfile hash and node version to cache key, implemented feature flag via repo-config. PTAL.
Sofia Martinez: Tests look good, but the concurrency group names should be scoped per-repo to avoid cross-repo throttling — see my inline suggestion.
Aisha Patel: Updated concurrency group naming to include repo name and environment. Added comments describing rationale.
Ethan Zhao: Approving pending CI green. One nit: release workflow should have additional audit logging for artifact provenance.
Aisha Patel: Added artifact provenance metadata and pushed a follow-up commit.
CI bot: Initial run: test matrix failed on node 20 / ubuntu-22 due to flaky integration test (timeout). Rerun succeeded after increasing timeout.
Ops: Observability metrics added — will monitor cache.hit_rate; early numbers show cache hit improving from ~62% to ~81% on subsequent runs.
Release manager: Manual approval gate added; we will enable for staging releases first.
release_notes: Refactor CI workflows: split lint/test/release, improve cache key generation (includes lockfile/node version), standardize Node 20 across jobs, add concurrency and rate-limit hygiene, harden release automation with approval gate and retries; improves CI latency and cache hit rates.
